rows.question: Aap kitne baje tak khule ho?
rows.text: Main Sweet Crumbs Bakery ki AI assistant hoon. Hum Monday se Saturday subah 9 baje se raat 9 baje tak, aur Sunday subah 10 baje se shaam 6 baje tak khule rehte hain.

rows.text: Hello! Main Sweet Crumbs Bakery ki AI assistant hoon. Ek kilo cake 650 rupees se start hote hain.
